evidenceKind: measured model executions on synthetic task inputs
scope: Explicit invocation plus successful shell read of the exact supplied Skill body in three clean candidate contexts; baseline uses no Skill and no commands. Shared v2 task contract. No MCP connections supplied, no user config; read-only sandbox. Private runtime homes, stderr and raw command metadata excluded.
limitations: Three small tasks, one run per variant, all pass in both variants; no success-rate improvement shown.
Explicit-file-read treatment adds a model/tool round trip; native total input delta is not the standalone Skill body size, per-request unique context or billed cost.
Parallel scheduling and provider cache state confound latency. Timing includes explicit file reading. No statistical or production performance claim.
Task prompts, verifier and delivery settings changed from v1; do not pool or directly attribute differences between rounds. Old results and grades remain unchanged.
Body read is attested, but comprehension, causal effect and implicit triggering are not.
Benchmark pass_rate counts assertions; Thermo success requires every assertion.
safeArtifactsVerified: All six outcomes and grades rechecked against frozen expected answers; paired metrics generated by Thermo; native body outputs attested; copied credentials absent.
